Organizer: Maeve
Duration: 30 min | All hands, account + creative (13)
Invitees: Raj Wexler, Sam Jovanovic, Grace Ahmadi, Dmitri Szabo, Tess Mbatha, Sana Brennan, + broader pod

PURPOSE
To socialize where we've landed on the Anchor initiative and level-set the org on go-forward posture.

AGENDA
1. Context-setting (Maeve, 5 min)
High-level narrative on why Anchor matters to our omnichannel north star.

2. Leadership readout (Raj, 10 min)
Raj walks through the finalized positioning framework and the brand architecture refresh. Already signed off by the client, so this is informational.

3. Workflow implications (Sam, 5 min)
Sam to share how intake, trafficking and asset handoffs will flow under the new operating model. A one-pager will be circulated.

4. Resourcing snapshot (Grace, 5 min)
Updated pod allocations and utilization targets for Q3. Owners will be notified individually.

5. Housekeeping (Dmitri, 5 min)
New naming conventions for the shared drive and the Anchor Slack channel.

NOTES
No pre-read required. Deck will be shared post-session for async consumption. Tess and Sana, please flag any blockers via the usual channels.

Cameras on appreciated."}]}
